content.value_statement: Missing disclosures and unclear checkout terms can expose EU webshops to consumer complaints. This guide helps an AI assistant review key requirements and draft practical corrections.
actual_capabilities: Guides reviews of pre-contract disclosures and their placement throughout the purchase funnel.
Directs checks of order button wording and hidden checkout costs.
Supports drafting withdrawal forms and 14-day notices with applicable exceptions.
Guides reviews of price display and delivery cost transparency.
Directs checks of cookie banner refusal paths.
Provides an example audit summary highlighting product manufacturer information gaps.
limitations: The folder contains only a public guide, not the original package scripts, extension source, or templates.
Guidance focuses on EU and Belgian consumer law; other national requirements need separate review.
Outputs are working drafts, not legal advice, certification, or a guarantee of compliance.
Live website inspection and current legal verification depend on the host agent tools and supplied evidence.

use_cases.title: Prepare a webshop launch review
use_cases.description: Review disclosures, withdrawal notices, and cookie consent before opening an EU consumer webshop.

use_cases.title: Check a checkout implementation
use_cases.description: Inspect supplied checkout screens for hidden delivery charges, unclear totals, and unsuitable order button wording.

use_cases.title: Prepare client remediation tasks
use_cases.description: Turn documented compliance gaps into reviewable tasks covering product information, consent controls, and customer policies.

prompt_templates.title: Start a basic review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these webshop screenshots for EU consumer disclosure gaps: [screenshots]. List observed issues and questions that need more evidence.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of supplied storefront evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Review checkout transparency
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this checkout flow for a shop selling [products] in [country]: [screenshots and text]. Check button wording, total prices, and delivery charges.

prompt_templates.title: Draft withdrawal documents
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a withdrawal notice and form for [products] sold in [countries] using [business details]. Identify applicable exceptions and missing facts for legal review.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate policy drafting with jurisdiction and product context.

prompt_templates.title: Build an evidence-based remediation plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess [shop evidence] for EU and Belgian consumer requirements. Cover disclosures, checkout, withdrawal, prices, and cookie refusal. Separate observed gaps from assumptions. Prioritize fixes and identify national-law questions for counsel.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review across several purchase funnel stages.

output_examples.input: The checkout shows delivery charges only after payment confirmation. The order button says Continue.
output: Observed gap: Delivery charges appear after the customer commits to payment.
Recommended correction: Show applicable delivery charges and the final total before the order is placed.
Review needed: If Continue places a binding order, replace it with wording that clearly communicates the payment obligation.

output_examples.input: The cookie banner offers Accept all. Refusal requires opening settings and navigating another screen.
output: Observed gap: The refusal path requires more steps than acceptance.
Recommended correction: Provide a clear refusal option alongside acceptance and review its visibility.
Verification needed: Confirm nonessential cookies remain inactive before consent and after refusal.

best_practices: Provide the selling countries, product types, checkout evidence, and existing customer policies before requesting an audit.
Require each observation to reference supplied evidence and identify assumptions or missing information.
Have qualified counsel verify current rules, national variations, and withdrawal exceptions before publishing legal documents.
anti_patterns: Treating generated findings as legal certification or a guarantee against enforcement.
Assuming the public guide includes automated scanners, bundled templates, or live browsing tools.
Applying one withdrawal policy to every product and EU member state without checking exceptions.

faq.question: Which compliance areas does the guide cover?
faq.answer: It covers pre-contract information, order button wording, withdrawal notices, pricing and delivery costs, and cookie consent refusal paths.

faq.question: Does it include an automated website scanner?
faq.answer: No scanner is included in this folder. Website access depends on the host agent tools; you can also supply screenshots and text.

faq.question: Does it cover every EU national requirement?
faq.answer: The guide focuses on EU and Belgian consumer law. Other national requirements require separate verification.

faq.question: Can it help draft withdrawal documents?
faq.answer: It guides drafting withdrawal forms and 14-day notices. Product-specific exceptions and final wording require legal review.

faq.question: Are the original package scripts and templates included?
faq.answer: No. The source explicitly states that scripts, extension source, and templates from the original package are absent.

faq.question: Does the output guarantee compliance?
faq.answer: No. Output is a working review, not legal advice or a compliance guarantee.
